risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified operating, shipment, margin, capital spending, and market-demand information, supporting relatively transparent disclosure. Risk is moderated through optimistic framing and forward-looking assumptions, including aerospace destocking, competitive price pressure, automotive launch delays, margin compression, and execution inefficiencies. The excerpt is technically dense and includes some management-selected non-run-rate and value-added metrics that may complicate comparability with GAAP results.
